user.title: Tuya charger setup
user.description: How would you like to find your charger?

scan.title: Discovered chargers
scan.description: Select the charger found on your network, or choose 'Enter manually'.

cloud.title: Tuya Cloud credentials
cloud.description: From iot.tuya.com: create a Cloud project, link your Smart Life account, then paste the Access ID and Access Secret here. Used only to read your device list (device_id + local key) — never for telemetry.

cloud_device.title: Select your charger
cloud_device.description: Pick the charger among the devices in your Tuya account. Its local key is filled in automatically, and its IP is located on your network.

credentials.title: Charger credentials
credentials.description: Enter the local key and confirm the other settings.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure charger
reconfigure.description: Update the address or credentials without losing history.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the local key
reauth_confirm.description: The charger at {host} is answering but its replies can no longer be decrypted, which happens when it is re-paired. Enter the new local key.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach charger with these settings.
error.cloud_auth_failed: Could not reach the Tuya Cloud. Check the Access ID, Access Secret and region.
error.cloud_no_devices: No devices in this Tuya IoT project. Did you link your Smart Life account to it?
error.no_devices_found: No Tuya devices found on the network. Enter credentials manually.
error.connection_refused: The charger refused the connection. These chargers accept a single local connection at a time - close the Smart Life app and disable any other Tuya integration pointing at it, then retry.
error.invalid_credentials: The charger answered but its replies could not be decrypted. Check the local key and the protocol version; re-pairing the charger changes the key.

abort.not_tuya_ev_charger: The device that changed IP is not a configured Tuya charger.

data.max_charge_current_a: Maximum charging current (A, 0 = charger limit) - your circuit's rating, not the charger's
data.surplus_battery_net_discharge_sensor_inv: Invert net battery discharge sensor sign
data.surplus_allow_battery_discharge_for_ev: Allow battery discharge for EV charging
data.surplus_max_battery_discharge_for_ev_w: Max allowed battery discharge power for EV (W)
data.vehicles: Vehicles for per-car energy tracking (comma separated)
data.max_house_power_w: Maximum house power for load balancing (W, 0 = off)
data.max_inverter_power_w: Maximum inverter output (W, 0 = off) - protects a hybrid inverter; needs the total-load sensor below
data.total_load_sensor_entity_id: Total household load sensor (for the inverter limit) - total consumption, not the grid meter
data.off_peak_windows: Off-peak windows (e.g. 22:00-06:00, 12:30-14:30; empty = charge any time)
data.off_peak_price: Off-peak price per kWh (0 = no cost tracking)
data.peak_price: Peak price per kWh (0 = no cost tracking)

error.invalid_dp_profile: Custom DP mapping rejected: {dp_profile_problem}. Valid fields: {dp_profile_fields}.

state.adjust_cooldown_active: Waiting before changing the current again
state.adjust_current: Adjusting the current to the surplus
state.battery_soc_below_threshold: Waiting: the house battery is too low
state.below_stop_threshold: Stopped: surplus below the stop threshold
state.failed_set_startup_current: The charger refused the starting current
state.force_charge_failed_set_current: Forced charge — the charger refused the current
state.force_charge_failed_start: Forced charge — the charger refused to start
state.grid_sensor_unavailable: The grid power sensor is unavailable
state.insufficient_surplus_current: Surplus too small for the minimum current
state.inverter_limit_no_headroom: Stopped: the inverter is at its output limit
state.inverter_limit_reduced: Reduced to stay under the inverter output limit
state.load_limit_no_headroom: Stopped: the house is at its power limit
state.load_limit_reduced: Reduced to stay under the house power limit
state.min_runtime_guard: Holding: the session is too short to stop yet
state.no_allowed_currents: The charger offers no usable current
state.no_coordinator_data: No data from the charger yet
state.no_target_current: No current the surplus can sustain
state.start_delay_pending: About to start — waiting to confirm the surplus holds
state.stop_delay_pending: About to stop — waiting to confirm the surplus is gone
state.target_already_reached: Already at the current the surplus allows
state.tariff_deadline: Charging now to meet the departure time

connection_refused.title: Charger refused the connection
connection_refused.description: The charger at {host} is reachable but refuses its control port. These chargers accept a single local connection at a time — check that the Smart Life app or another Tuya integration is not holding it.

confirm.title: Hide advanced entities
confirm.description: This charger registered {count} advanced or diagnostic entities that a fresh install would now hide (raw state codes, self-test, surplus internals). Disabling them tidies the device page; you can re-enable any of them afterwards and they will not be touched again.

force_charge_for.name: Force charge for a duration
force_charge_for.description: Charge unconditionally for a number of minutes, ignoring surplus regulation.

entry_id.name: Charger
entry_id.description: Which charger to act on. Required when several are configured.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: How many minutes to force charging for.

pause_surplus.name: Pause surplus mode
pause_surplus.description: Suspend solar surplus regulation for a number of minutes.

entry_id.name: Charger
entry_id.description: Which charger to act on. Required when several are configured.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: How many minutes to suspend regulation for.

profile_assistant.name: Suggest a surplus profile
profile_assistant.description: Analyse recent behaviour and suggest a surplus profile, optionally applying it.

entry_id.name: Charger
entry_id.description: Which charger to analyse. Required when several are configured.

apply.name: Apply
apply.description: Apply the suggested profile instead of only reporting it.

set_surplus_profile.name: Set the surplus profile
set_surplus_profile.description: Switch the surplus regulation profile (eco, balanced or fast).

entry_id.name: Charger
entry_id.description: Which charger to act on. Required when several are configured.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: One of eco, balanced or fast.
